Sanctions imposed by any of these countries could disrupt our supply of critical components among our manufacturing facilities in the U.S., Germany, Russia or Belarus, and cause us to shift all or portions of work occurring in Russia or Belarus to other countries.
In addition, if sanctions or retaliatory sanctions targeting the banking sector are imposed, we may not be able to transfer cash to and from Russia to fund operations or repatriate surplus liquidity.
